# set a hotbar slot (inventory menu slot 36 = hotbar 0), copy it to the next slot, set another stack
I C 0 minecraft:stone*64
MENU C cid=0 type=inventory state=1 carried=empty
MS 36 minecraft:stone*64
I C 0 minecraft:stone*64
I C 1 minecraft:stone*64
MENU C cid=0 type=inventory state=1 carried=empty
MS 36 minecraft:stone*64
MS 37 minecraft:stone*64
I C 0 minecraft:stone*64
I C 1 minecraft:stone*64
I C 2 minecraft:iron_pickaxe*1{minecraft:enchantments:{minecraft:efficiency:3}}
MENU C cid=0 type=inventory state=1 carried=empty
MS 36 minecraft:stone*64
MS 37 minecraft:stone*64
MS 38 minecraft:iron_pickaxe*1{minecraft:enchantments:{minecraft:efficiency:3}}
